subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should this issue move to an implementation attempt now, or should maintainers first collect the reporter's 2026.6.9/2026.6.11 process samples to identify the exact final-phase hot path?
rationale: The issue is credible and high impact, but current source points to multiple plausible hot paths and the latest release still reproduces without attached samples that identify the blocked JS frame.

options.title: Collect samples first
options.body: Ask for or inspect the three watchdog process samples, then queue a narrow fix against the confirmed rebuild, state-store, or narrative path.

options.title: Queue exploratory repair
options.body: Start a performance fix PR from the suspected plugin-state/promotion path, accepting a higher chance of churn if the samples later point elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Collect samples first
recommendation.body: Ask for or inspect the three watchdog process samples, then queue a narrow fix against the confirmed rebuild, state-store, or narrative path.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest affected release and recent memory-core hardening history make this the best current routing candidate for deciding whether the release evidence is enough.
